reading the market in terms of FL in the different scale is the real last piece of this puzzle , i can go to more details but i want others to find this last piece of gold them selves , just as a hint there is no matter in TFs , we just should read the FLs in terms of Order Flow , Order Flow is the spirit of subjects that has no difference in TFs.

there is no turning in price without Free Order Flow . and FLs are the only places that have Free Order Flow . the target and the place that price came from will tell us where there is Free Order Flow in the market . try to find when we have deep RT and when we don't then reading the market is easy as the way that IF do .

regards

Salivan

If it makes sense in the bigger picture then a deep RT can reveal the intention of ITs, as an additional confluence factor, in case we are not sure about direction (ITs loaded with longs or shorts?). How do different scales play together?

Trying to investigate the question, is it still "safe" to trade lower scales when bigger scales signaled an intention?

As always until now, sometimes yes, sometimes no. But on the other hand this is what we do everyday, if the monthly or weekly shows a signal, do you trade only in that direction on 5m? I don't think so. Since the market consists of fractals, trading smaller plays within bigger plays should just work fine

By the way, this is a bitcoin chart, I wonder who are the ITs there ?

Hi Jurij,

I have been working on the same Question. I tried only trading in the direction of the HTF scale Engulf but when this is 4 hour or higher the best trades are on a deep retrace of the HTF Engulf at least for R:R.

Having said that trading the LTF scale engulf in the opposite direction of the HTF engulf produces good trades.

With patience I guess waiting on the deep retrace of the HTF scale engulf is best but you also miss so many trades. I find by taking what the market has to offer on LTF Scale one can more than cover the cost of getting the HTF Scale wrong, when it appears we have retraced enough ie nearing the extreme of this scale I wait and play the HTF Scale again in the direction of the HTF engulf.

Without getting the LTF action on the chart you posted I can see where engulfs against the HTF can add pips to your account.

As you can see putting them all together is still very confusing for me but I do mange to cover getting it wrong which keeps me green while I learn.

I love your journal that badge should already be shining.

I don't like that I fell for the retailers trap, especially the PAZ thing:IF wrote: If the signal is given by the market mover (an engulf into a new zone), then price is very unlikely to break the extreme of the zone it just came from. So, if you have the patience to wait at
